title: pilea opaca
intro: Pilea opaca, commonly known as the "Aluminum Plant" or "Panama Hat Plant", is a species of flowering plant in the family Urticaceae. This plant is known for its air-purifying properties and is often used in indoor spaces to promote a healthier environment. The health benefits of Pilea opaca include reducing stress and anxiety, improving air quality, and boosting mood. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenes, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
